GOVERNANCE · WHO DOES WHAT
The person who asks never approves.

Roles decide what you can do. Company and hotel scope decide where. Both are enforced on the server.

P
PriyaPORTFOLIO OWNER
D
DavidEXECUTIVE APPROVER
M
MariaHOTEL OPERATOR
S
SamPROPERTY FINANCE
✓
STEP 1Priya reviews the evidence, drafts the Driftwood Cove housekeeping plan and requests approval.
STEP 2David, an independent executive, approves and activates the plan, or rejects it.
STEP 3Maria confirms the rules and runs the new schedule. Sam checks payroll. Each touches only their own team's task.
STEP 4Priya records the outcome with evidence and closes the plan. Overdue work escalates automatically.

Priya cannot approve her own plan. David's approval right does not let him create, update or close it.
